purpose: safely read one allowed file with byte/range cap.

source.source_text: Purpose: safely read one allowed file with byte/range cap. Input: path:string, offset?:integer, max_bytes?:1..1048576, encoding?:utf8|base64|metadata. Output: bounded content/metadata and truncation flag. Contract: L1 read_only; scope mac.files.read; target path; timeout 10000ms; cap 1MiB; network none; filesystem read_allowed_roots; protected secret content always denied; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 2 planned.
